intent: Sum available_today_quantity across every Graz PowerTool store for the single Heco 'HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer' variant whose fastener_type is 'threaded rod', counting 0-availability branches, and answer 'count: %d'.

params.product_family_name: Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer

success_criteria: Resolve exactly one SKU: brand=Heco, family='Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer', property fastener_type='threaded rod'
Enumerate all stores where city='Graz' (every branch, including ones with no inventory row / 0 availability)
Sum available_today_quantity over all Graz stores via LEFT JOIN, treating missing inventory rows as 0
refs cite the product record_path and EVERY Graz store record_path

args: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = 'Heco' AND pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer' AND pvp.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'threaded rod';
SELECT store_id, store_name, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz' ORDER BY store_id;

WITH target_product AS (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = 'Heco' AND pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer' AND pvp.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'threaded rod'), graz_stores AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Graz') SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total_available FROM graz_stores gs CROSS JOIN target_product tp LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = gs.store_id AND si.product_sku = tp.product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Catalogue is in proc/catalog, stores are in proc/stores
